messages.subject: problem with plyr -ddply
parts:
Folks

I am having some problems with ddply. I want to be able to split up a
dataframe, convert it to zoo, then aggregate the data from weekly to
monthly and stick it together as another data frame.

I can get it to write to a list in the way I want (using dlply) but
not to a dataframe. The error message says ... "Error in
list_to_dataframe(res, attr(.data, "split_labels")) : Results are not
equal lengths". But they both seem to me to be the same size (ie 7).

Any help much appreciated.

simeon

data.frame': 312 obs. of 5 variables:
$ Date :Class 'Date' num [1:312] 13970 14000 14031 14061 14092 ...
$ xx : num 152 164 277 189 153 ...
$ yy : num 325104 357972 505634 302559 159574 ...
$ Media: Factor w/ 7 levels "Affiliates","Display",..: 3 3 3 3 3 3 3
3 3 3 ...
$ zz : num 2137 2188 1825 1605 1042 ...


to.monthly <- function (df) {
df.z <- zoo(df[c("yy","zz")],df$Date)
df.zz<- aggregate(df.z,as.yearmon,sum,na.rm=T)
df.zz$CPA <- with(df.zz,ifelse(zz==0,0,yy/zz))
return(df.zz)
}

df.month <- ddply(weekly.df,.(Media),to.monthly)
df.month.l <- dlply(weekly.df,.(Media),to.monthly)

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: problem with plyr -ddply
parts:
Two options:

1. Make sure your aggregation function returns a data frame:

to.monthly <- function (df) {
df.z <- zoo(df[c("yy","zz")],df$Date)
df.zz<- aggregate(df.z,as.yearmon,sum,na.rm=T)
df.zz$CPA <- with(df.zz,ifelse(zz==0,0,yy/zz))

as.data.frame(df.zz)
}

2. Do the aggregation directly:

df.month <- ddply(weekly.df, .(Media, month = as.yearmon(Date)),
colwise(sum, .(yy, zz))
df.month$CPA <- with(df.month, yy / zz)
df.month[is.na(df.month)] <- 0

Regards,

Hadley
